source_refs.note: Step 2: Annealing of Primer: a main subheading of 20.3.1 Steps of PCR, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 160-160.

blocks.text: The solution is allowed to cool to about 60°C. As it cools, the forward and the backward primers anneal or hybridize to the single-stranded DNA at its complementary regions. So, the rest of the fragment remains single-stranded.
